sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Welcome to Lesson 6.11: Real-World Case Studies in Exploratory Data Analysis. Up to this point in Track 6, we have examined univariate shapes, bivariate distributions, robust estimators, dimensionality reduction, and cognitive pitfalls in isolation.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: In this masterclass capstone, we subject these theoretical tools to real-world operational tabular databases: the Ames Housing econometric valuation benchmark and the Telecom subscription churn survival dataset.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Every business domain exhibits a distinct mathematical signature that dictates exploratory workflows. Financial accounting data suffers from deterministic identity collinearity.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Real estate econometric data contains Pareto price skewness, spatial autocorrelation, and partial-estate liquidation outliers. Subscription services feature time-to-event right-censoring, while healthcare models risk dangerous target proxy distortions.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Published by Dean De Cock in 2011, the Ames dataset details 2,930 residential property sales in Ames, Iowa, with 79 explanatory variables. It replaced the outdated 1978 Boston Housing dataset as the premier benchmark for econometric modeling.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Under Rosen's hedonic pricing theory, property valuation decomposes into structural attributes like square footage and finish quality, alongside neighborhood spatial endowments. However, raw sale price exhibits heavy right skewness with gamma-one equal to positive 1.88.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: The Box-Cox transformation family optimizes a continuous power parameter lambda. When lambda equals 1, the data is unscaled; when lambda equals 0, it maps to the natural logarithm.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Here is the formal proof of multiplicative error stabilization: in real estate, appraisal uncertainty scales as a percentage of property value, giving raw variance proportional to f of x squared. Taking the natural logarithm converts multiplicative error into constant additive variance sigma-squared.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: When plotting Above-Ground Living Area against SalePrice, two massive houses exceeding 4,500 square feet sold for under two hundred thousand dollars. Cook's Distance measures the total vector shift in regression coefficients when observation i is omitted.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: The formula isolates both the studentized residual and the leverage diagonal h-sub-i-i of the hat matrix. In Ames, these homes had Cook's D exceeding 1.25. De Cock discovered they were non-arms-length partial estate sales; removing them boosted cross-validation R-squared from 0.81 to 0.91.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Welcome to Interactive Lab 1: our Ames Housing Econometric Studio. Below, you can adjust the Box-Cox parameter lambda between minus 0.5 and plus 1.5 to inspect the price distribution histogram alongside the living-area scatter plot.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Toggle the outlier handling mode between keeping all observations and pruning Cook's distance outliers. Observe how lambda equals zero collapses skewness and pruning partial sales restores an R-squared above 0.90.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active Recall Checkpoint 6.11.1. In hedonic real estate modeling with multiplicative error Y equals f of x times 1 plus eta, why does the Box-Cox transformation at lambda equals 0 restore homoscedasticity, and what makes high-sqft liquidation sales so destructive to OLS?

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Real estate transactions violate the independent and identically distributed assumption of OLS due to Tobler's First Law of Geography: nearby properties are more correlated than distant ones.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Moran's I quantifies spatial autocorrelation using a geographic weight matrix w-sub-i-j. In Ames, Moran's I equals plus 0.58 with p-value under 0.001, proving that neighborhood fixed effects or spatial autoregressive models are required to prevent serially clustered residual variance.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Turning to our second benchmark: enterprise customer retention. In subscription services, classifying customers as simply churned versus retained ignores the fundamental dimension of time-to-event.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active subscribers are right-censored: we know they have survived up to current tenure T-sub-i, but their future churn event remains unobserved. Treating censored customers as non-churners or deleting them induces severe survival bias.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: The Kaplan-Meier product-limit estimator computes the non-parametric cumulative probability of surviving past time t, adjusting for censored accounts at risk in each step.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Plotting S-hat of t reveals the famous Onboarding Valley of Death: over 31 percent of customer churn occurs during the first 3 months of contract inception. Beyond month 12, the hazard rate flattens into an exponential survival plateau.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: To establish rigorous statistical bounds on survival curves, Major Greenwood derived the asymptotic variance of S-hat of t in 1926 via the delta method applied to log survival.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Notice how Greenwood's formula scales by S-hat squared times the summation of d-sub-i divided by n-sub-i times n-sub-i minus d-sub-i. As sample cohorts diminish in the late tenure tail, risk denominators shrink, widening the confidence envelope.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Welcome to Interactive Lab 2: our Telco Survival & Churn Dynamics Studio. Here you can explore the empirical Kaplan-Meier step function alongside Greenwood's 95 percent confidence envelope.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Compare Month-to-Month contracts against One-Year and Two-Year cohorts, and inspect the Multicollinearity Variance Inflation Factor gauge to see why TotalCharges inverts regression coefficients.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active Recall Checkpoint 6.11.2. In subscription churn analysis, how does Greenwood's formula capture diminishing cohort certainty over time, and why does including TotalCharges alongside MonthlyCharges and tenure produce sign inversion in regression coefficients?

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: In tabular enterprise systems, multicollinearity frequently arises from accounting definitions rather than natural physics. TotalCharges is approximately MonthlyCharges times tenure.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: When regressing TotalCharges against the other two, R-squared exceeds 0.98, pushing VIF beyond 50. This inflates standard errors by more than sevenfold and flips the sign of MonthlyCharges into negative, leading executives to false pricing conclusions.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: To operationalize these safeguards, we implement an enterprise EDA audit pipeline using Pydantic V2, NumPy, and SciPy. The pipeline automatically evaluates Box-Cox parameters, flags Cook's distance outliers, and computes Moran's I and survival curves.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Any feature exhibiting VIF above 10 or Cook's D above 4 over n triggers an automated quarantine alert before downstream modeling pipelines can ingest poisoned features.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Congratulations on completing Lesson 6.11! We have synthesized hedonic econometrics, Box-Cox homoscedasticity proofs, Cook's distance leverage metrics, spatial Moran's I, Kaplan-Meier survival curves, Greenwood variance, and VIF multicollinearity screening.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Seal your mastery with our 4 production pillars: stabilize multiplicative errors with logarithms, prune high-leverage liquidation anomalies, model right-censored durations with product-limits, and screen deterministic accounting identities before training.
